gui.pathwaysofthebeyond.no_pathway: Chưa có con đường. Ngươi vẫn chỉ là người.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.abyssal_eye.lor: It does not blink, because it has no lids - only patience.
A year, folded small. Unfolding it makes the room remember being younger.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.black_blood_via: It flows upward when it thinks it is unobserved.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.black_book.desc: Bound in something that was never an animal. The pages rearrange while you read them.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.black_book.draw: Each reading risks a hallucination, and one page is always blank in a different way.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.black_book.pass: Opens the Codex of Forbidden Knowledge: grants recipes, ritual knowledge and Sequence insight.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.brass_key.desc: A key with no matching lock, warm to the touch, engraved 'FOR EMERGENCIES ONLY'.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.brass_key.drawb: Each use costs a small amount of maximum Sanity until you sleep. Some doors do not close.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.brass_key.passi: Opens a short blink through space - a Door that insists it was always there.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.corrupted_heart: Still beating. It beats in your rhythm now, not its original owner's.
A brass-and-glass eye set in a sealed reliquary. The pupil tracks things with no bodies.
While worn, Sanity drains steadily; and every use makes the eye's pupil larger.
Reveals supernatural entities, hidden ores and invisible marks in a wide radius.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.faceless_skin.l: Soft as a glove, blank as a page. It fits almost anyone, which is the problem.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.grave_earth.lor: Soil that has learned the shape of a body and refuses to forget it.
Fed on moonlight rather than rot. It glows with the colour of a decision you have already made.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.nightshade_ashe: What is left of a plant that was fed a secret. Very fine. Stains the fingers permanently.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.occult_chalk.lo: White, cold, and slightly greasy. Drawing with it is a promise the ground remembers.
Points to the nearest supernatural structure or active ritual.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.pathway_codex.d: Victorian occult ledger: Pathway screen, Sequences, digestion and lore.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.purified_salt.l: The cheapest protection in the occult world, and the one most often skipped.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.ritual_dagger.d: Open a palm for the circle; provides ritual blood.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.silver_needle.l: Threads use it; so do surgeons, and so does the Marionettist.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.soul_fragment.l: A piece of continuity. Warm. It attempts, very faintly, to be the person it came from.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.soul_thread_spo: Crafting component; the raw material of binding.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.spirit_flower.l: It opens only when nobody is watching, and it closes the instant you look away. Collectors have learned to gather it with a mirror.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.spirit_tonic.de: Restores Sanity at the cost of a temporary Corruption tick.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.starless_crysta: A crystal with no internal light. Under a red moon it glows anyway, which nobody has explained.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.thread_shears.d: Cut a bound Soul Thread. The puppet remembers being cut.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.veil_dust.lore: The residue of a door being opened nearby. Tastes of copper and sleep.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.ward_charm.desc: Slows Sanity loss and blocks one possession attempt. Then it is spent.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.whispering_bell: A cracked brass bell. Its clapper was removed by someone who was careful.
Something specific hears the bell. It is already on its way; the bell simply tells it where you are.
Ringing it reveals hidden entities, summons spirit entities and spikes nearby supernatural activity.
item.pathwaysofthebeyond.whispering_bone: Hold it to your ear and it finishes sentences you were thinking.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.bell_answere: Something answers the bell. It is not close, yet.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.beyond_unloc: BÊN KIA đã nhận ra ngươi.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.digesting_ho: Ngươi không thể uống thêm khi đang tiêu hoá.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.digestion_re: Something in you rejects the pathway.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.event_empty_: The village is quiet in the wrong way.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.event_red_mo: The moon has turned the colour of an old wound.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.event_the_no: Something very large has become aware of you.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.event_the_wa: You are being watched. It has not decided anything yet.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.event_whispe: Everything is whispering, and none of it is aimed at you.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.insufficient: You are not far enough along the pathway for this.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.lost_control: Ngươi không còn là kẻ đang bước đi.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.potion_consu: Dược tính ngấm vào. Cơ thể ngươi bắt đầu phản đối.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.ritual_compl: Nghi lễ khép lại sạch sẽ. Không khí có mùi đồng thau.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.ritual_faile: Vòng tròn vỡ. Có thứ gì đó đã chú ý.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.ritual_start: Vòng tròn đã mở. Đừng bước ra ngoài.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.soul_exit: Thân xác ngươi ở lại. Đừng đi quá xa.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.soul_return: Ngươi rơi trở lại vào chính mình.
message.pathwaysofthebeyond.soul_snap: The tether parts. Something is standing over your body.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.black_empero: Empire is a ritual performed continuously. Its adepts do not command people; they command the arrangements that make people behave.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.death.lore: The pathway keeps a ledger of everything that has stopped. Its believers are not morbid; they are administrative. Nothing is lost, only filed.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.door.lore: Space is a corridor with too many hinges. The Door's adepts do not travel; they arrive, and they seal behind themselves in ways that should not hold.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.error.lore: A flaw that propagates. The Error pathway has no doctrine, because doctrine is something it can corrupt and it would rather keep its options open.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.fool.lore: Not a god of trickery but of the space between: the Fool is the pathway of those who are not there, of masks worn so long they grow a face. Its church teaches that reality is a negotiation, and that the Fool is the only honest deity, because it never claims to be real.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.mother.lore: Growth without permission. The Mother pathway is generous in the way a flood is generous, and its gardens are full of things that should not flower.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.sun.lore: Light that burns what it blesses. The Sun's priests are healers and executioners in the same vestment, and its higher sequences are remembered mostly as brightness and then as absence.
pathway.pathwaysofthebeyond.visionary.lo: The mind is the largest country. Visionaries map it, tax it, and occasionally declare war on a thought until it apologises.
